title: [ML] Option to delete user-added annotations for the reset/delete job APIs

timeline.message:
[ML] Add an option to delete user-added annotations for the reset and delete job APIs

Currently there is no way to remove user-added annotations when a job is deleted or reset.
This change adds an option - delete_user_annotations - to both the delete and reset job APIs.
The default value is false, to keep the behaviour of these calls as it is currently.

timeline.body:
Currently there is no way to remove user-added annotations when a job is deleted or reset.

This change adds an option - `delete_user_annotations` - to both the delete and reset job APIs.

The default value is `false`, to keep the behaviour of these calls as it is currently.

Closes #74310

timeline.body: Hi @edsavage, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.
This needs to be added to other methods in this class, e.g. `equals`, `hashCode`, `writeTo`.
This needs a BWC check, as it won't exist on old versions. `if (in.getVersion().onOrAfter(Version.V_8_7_0))`.
This needs to be added to other methods in this class, e.g. `equals`, `hashCode`, `writeTo`.
If `deleteUserAnnotations` is true then it just shouldn't add a filter on the username.  That will make it delete everything.

timeline.body: We want to delete annotations created by all users, not just the superuser.  So the test condition should be that if `deleteUserAnnotations` is true then the search _doesn't_ mention the `_xpack` user.

timeline.body:
Please add the new parameter to the specs for these 2 APIs in `rest-api-spec/src/main/resources/rest-api-spec/api`.

Also, please use the new parameter in one of the tests in `x-pack/plugin/src/yamlRestTest/resources/rest-api-spec/test/ml` - it's fine to just add it to an existing test rather than create a new test (but you can add a new test if it's easier). Having it mentioned in a YAML test will mean that the clients flight recorder sees the new argument and can include it in the auto-generated clients.

Finally, please can you create an issue labelled `:ml` in the `kibana` repo asking for UI changes to take advantage of this new parameter.
